title: Distinguish an unseen capture ID from fresh Director evidence
objective: Distinguish an unseen capture ID from fresh Director evidence. Preserve existing owner semantics and historical evidence.

evidence.summary: Independent findings and corrected external-audit claims.
Read-only probes with synthetic temporary fixtures; no paid API calls.

reproduction: The read-only probe passes a never-seen synthetic run ID with captured_at_utc=2026-08-08T14:01:34Z to check_director_freshness and receives fresh_ready=true. Archived Director contexts on August 9-14 reused that capture and reported DELTA_READY at ages up to 151.7 hours. Deduplication is not source freshness.

positive: Separate source age, timestamp validity and previously processed identity in readiness diagnostics.
Bind any execution cutoff to an existing current owner contract; if no authoritative cutoff exists, report the blocked decision rather than invent policy.
Fresh, valid, unseen evidence remains eligible under the existing owner contract; duplicates remain no-ops.
negative: Unseen identity alone cannot assert freshness; unreadable, missing, naive or future source timestamps cannot be presented as verified fresh.
Do not create a new market rule, freshness tolerance, API call, schedule or budget; do not mutate historical contexts.

forbidden_changes: restricted provider values in public artifacts
